Name: Armored Overhaul 3.0.1
Description: Bastion, Maelstrom and FRV upgrades, each its own option: tank power, grip, steering and suspension; 360-degree MBT turrets with traverse, elevation and aim range; an autoloader; driving from the gunner seat; gunner camera distance; FRV stability; and a vehicle indicator. With the Mod Options Menu, the options can be changed in game. Requires Bingus Shared Loader.

Options.Name: Tank Power
Options.Description: More pulling power for the Bastion and Maelstrom: quicker off the line and up slopes. Top speed is unchanged.

Options.Name: Tank Grip
Options.Description: More track grip for the Bastion and Maelstrom: less sliding on slopes and in turns.

SubOptions.Name: Maximum (x2)
SubOptions.Description: Twice the grip: the tanks stick to the ground.

Options.Name: Tank Steering
Options.Description: Quicker steering for the Bastion and Maelstrom: they start and stop turning sooner.

SubOptions.Name: Sharp (x2)
SubOptions.Description: Twice as quick: the tanks snap into turns.

Options.Name: Tank Suspension
Options.Description: Road wheels that work like a tank's: the game's tanks rest on their bump stops, so the wheels can't move. Here each wheel rests part-way down a longer travel and follows the ground, keeping its track down, well damped; the hull is no longer thrown sideways when one track unloads. The tanks ride a little higher than in the game.

SubOptions.Name: Balanced
SubOptions.Description: Half a metre of wheel travel, each wheel resting half-way: soaks up rough ground; the hull resists being rolled and the grip is shared between the tracks.

SubOptions.Name: Planted
SubOptions.Description: Stiffer, more damped wheels with a little less travel; the hull is very hard to roll and the tracks share almost all the grip.

Options.Name: Tank MBT Turrets
Options.Description: The Bastion and Maelstrom turrets turn all the way round like a main battle tank. The Maelstrom's missile pods and smoke launchers turn with it. Only you see the new turrets, and their armor always looks undamaged.

Options.Name: Tank Turret Traverse
Options.Description: How fast the Bastion and Maelstrom turrets turn (the game: 25 degrees a second). Works with or without MBT Turrets.

Options.Name: Tank Turret Elevation
Options.Description: How fast the Bastion and Maelstrom guns move up and down (the game: 35 degrees a second).

Options.Name: Tank Turret Aim Range
Options.Description: How far down and up the Bastion and Maelstrom guns aim (the game: 3 below to 25 above).

Options.Name: Tank Autoloader
Options.Description: The Bastion and Maelstrom main gun reloads by itself when it runs dry, at the normal reload speed (perks count). You can still reload by hand.

Options.Name: Gunner Drive
Options.Description: Drive from the gunner seat when the driver seat is empty: your movement keys drive, the gun works as normal, and a driver panel shows gear, rpm, speed and fuel. F sounds the horn; in the Maelstrom, Mouse 3 pops smoke. On a controller the left stick drives, its click sounds the horn and the right stick click pops smoke. A teammate who takes the wheel drives as normal, and getting out while it rolls brakes it to a stop. With the Mod Bindings Menu you can set your own keys (controls, tab MODS). Pick which vehicles.

SubOptions.Name: Tanks and FRV
SubOptions.Description: Both the tanks and the M-102 FRV.

SubOptions.Name: Tanks
SubOptions.Description: The Bastion and Maelstrom, from the gunner seat.

SubOptions.Name: FRV
SubOptions.Description: The M-102 FRV, from its gunner seat.

Options.Name: Tank Gunner Camera
Options.Description: Puts the Bastion and Maelstrom gunner camera lower and further back so you see more around the tank. It stays behind the turret as it turns.

SubOptions.Name: Close (1 m behind)
SubOptions.Description: The game's distance, 1.4 m up (the game: 2 m).

Options.Name: FRV Stability
Options.Description: Keeps the M-102, M-103 and M-104 FRVs on their wheels over rough ground, jumps and hard turns: a firmer front, longer suspension travel, a lower center of mass, more grip and weight, and a little more ground clearance. Engine and steering stay the game's own.

SubOptions.Name: Mild
SubOptions.Description: Half the change: still lively, far less likely to roll.

SubOptions.Name: Stable
SubOptions.Description: Stays upright over rough ground, jumps and hard turns; a quarter heavier.

SubOptions.Name: Planted
SubOptions.Description: Lower, grippier, stiffer and 40% heavier, and the chassis resists rolling: very hard to tip, slower to turn.

Options.Name: Vehicle Indicator
Options.Description: A small outline of your vehicle shows where the gun points compared to the hull, colored by health (blue to red). Works in the Bastion, the Maelstrom, the M-102 FRV and the M-103 Supply FRV, in any seat; the FRVs' tires each show their own health and go clear when popped. Only you see it.
